arguments.detail: Caller reported urgent symptoms: Achanak baayein haath aur seene mein tez dard uth raha hai aur thanda paseena aa raha hai.

reply: Yeh sunkar bahut chinta ho rahi hai. Yeh serious emergency ho sakti hai. Kripya turant nazdeeki hospital ke emergency room jayein. Main abhi clinic staff ko alert kar rahi hoon.
